via_capacity.note: counts and lists: the vias and plated holes that carry at least min_current_a; current_a: the largest current of a via's barrel steps (DC solution); capacity_a: estimate – the IPC-2152 conductor chart (fit in data/thermal.json, via_current) for the plating cross-section π·(d − t)·t at a temperature rise of 10 K, plating t = 25 µm (assumption, as the DC solver); a via runs cooler than a track of the same cross-section, so the chart is conservative for a via. A plated hole with a soldered lead carries most of its current in the lead: holes over the estimate are counted (plated_holes_over_capacity) but not warned.
